scheme_name: Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child
other_conditions: The applicant must be the only girl child of her parents
The girl student must be studying in Class 11 or 12 at a recognized private school
The tuition fees of the school must be less than ₹1,500 per month
The girl student must have passed the previous class
If the parents are government employees, a certificate from the head of the office confirming the applicant is the only child is required
If the parents are not government employees, an affidavit from a notary confirming the applicant is the only child is required
benefits_summary: A scholarship of ₹5,000 per year is given to eligible single girl child students, deposited directly into the student's bank account.
documents_required: Certificate from head of office confirming the applicant is the only child
Attested copy of the family list in the ration card
Affidavit from a notary confirming the applicant is the only child
Attested copy of the ration card
